name: Campingplatz Riegsee
beschreibung:
Located right on the picturesque Riegsee, this campsite promises relaxing days in close harmony with nature. Guests appreciate direct access for swimming and boating, alongside generous pitches facing the alpine panorama.

Nearby moorlands, historic villages, and gentle hiking trails offer a wealth of cultural and scenic discoveries.
kurzbeschreibung: Campingplatz Riegsee delights with direct lakeshore access to a pristine lake and splendid views of the Alps.
